answer: The dipper lowers his moulds into the wax vat, and the vat must stay hot or the coats go lumpy. Candle ash wick cutter taper charter is the dipping: a charter ash wick cutters hold after cutting room inspections. The atlas is the first mould, dipped at dawn; the cipher is the last, dipped before the vat cools, and the harbor is the vat itself, deep with yellow wax. A cheat must dip 73 false moulds and cool 73 false vats.
